import copy,json,work

def verify(request, policy, expected):
    request_before=copy.deepcopy(request); policy_before=copy.deepcopy(policy)
    actual=work.evaluate(request, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
    assert request == request_before and policy == policy_before
    assert set(actual) == {'needs_review','changed'} and len(actual) == 2

verify({'declared':['z','a','z','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','metadata':{'b':2,'a':1}},'z':{'kind':'missing'},'unrelated':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':{'metadata':{'a':1,'b':2},'hash':'1','kind':'file'},'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'unrelated':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['z','skip']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})

verify({'declared':['missing'],'saved':{},'current':{'missing':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})

requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))

assert all(set(result) == set(schema['required']) and len(result) == len(schema['required']) for result in report)
